summary: Backend-only non-regression after frontend ArUco feature + app.json rename ('MesureEscalier' → 'Mesure escalier'). All 53 pytest tests pass (100%): 24 engine regression, 18 auth/projects/RBAC/stats, 6 POC (icon.png + markers.pdf + results.md), 3 new V2 stairs HTTP flow (create+get+compute). app.json validated as valid JSON with expo.name='Mesure escalier' and plugins react-native-vision-camera + expo-build-properties present. Frontend Metro web preview bundles successfully (HTTP 200 on localhost:3000). Backend untouched by the ArUco feature — zero regression.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json: valid JSON. expo.name='Mesure escalier' (with space) — this changes what the Emergent 'Generate iOS build' form reads. Bundle identifier unchanged (com.mesurechassis.escalier), so no store-side impact.

app.json: plugin order looks fine (expo-router → splash → av → vision-camera → build-properties). 'useFrameworks: static' + deploymentTarget 15.1 is the standard combo required by react-native-vision-camera on iOS.

Coexistence of expo-av plugin AND a target to remove expo-av (per Expo Pointers, expo-av is deprecated — should migrate to expo-audio/expo-video). NOT a regression for this iteration, flagged for future cleanup.
Backend untouched: no router/service change; expected to be unaffected by ArUco frontend feature. Confirmed by full pytest suite green.
